title: The Crankbrothers Trail Speed Lace Seal Are For Wet Season Riding
content:
The wet, rainy, and cold season is approaching, and in areas where it’s ok to ride muddy trails, keeping your feet dry can be an ordeal. Crankbrothers‘ new Trail Speed Lace Seal shoes are designed for wet, cold rides. Its all-new Seal shoe lineup is engineered to keep you riding well into the off-season. The silhouette features reflective hits for visibility when riding at dusk. With a waterproof membrane and a unique 360° ankle wrap to keep the elements out, these Seal shoes keep you comfortable when conditions get uncomfortable.

Available in clipless ($229.99) or flat pedal ($209.99) at Crankbrothers.com or your local dealer.
